name: sayso
description: With your permission, SaySo reads your shared iPhone screen and uses your accessory for tapping and scrolling. Stop directly in SaySo at any time. 在你授权后，SaySo 读屏并通过配件帮你点、滚动；你可随时在 SaySo App 内停止。
